items.title: Alcide "Slow Drag" Pavageau and Lawrence Marrero Interview, 1957-09-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Mr. Babajot, can you tell me when you were born?

ctx.x: Mr. Babajot, can you tell me when you were born?

Yes, Mr. Bill, I was born in 1888, March to 7. And I took, played guitar, learned how to play guitar in 1906, up to 1927. And on 1928 up to 1957, I was playing bass. That's 30 years ago. And 21 years playing guitar. To make it 51 years, guitar and bass, I was playing. I took a soapbox.
